Change 12: outside the goal window → status refused, reason outside_window

click_id and code together are refused locally

Goal key "account-opened" is refused locally
Goal key "a" is refused locally

A reference is required

send_batch posts {events} and returns per-item results without throwing
An empty batch is refused locally
More than 500 events are refused locally
A locally invalid event throws with its index and nothing is sent
A full reversal sends goal and reference only
A reversal needs a reference
Background: three goal() calls and flush → one batch request, in order
Background: batch_size 2 and five goals → batches of 2, 2 and 1
flush with nothing queued sends nothing and returns true
A failed batch item goes to on_error (mapped by its status and error); goal() never throws
A non-retryable whole-batch failure drops the events and calls on_error once
A retryable whole-batch failure re-queues the events; after 3 failed rounds they are dropped
A whole-batch 501 is not retryable: one request, the events are dropped and passed to on_error at once
Re-queued events are sent on the next flush, ahead of newer ones
When the queue is full the oldest event is dropped (warning + on_error queue_full)
goal() with an invalid key never throws: on_error, nothing queued
close() flushes; goal() after close goes to on_error client_closed
goal() in sync mode: a 422 goes to on_error, never thrown
